name: r8-g-e2-singletile
author: solx-loop
description: The fused pass 1 (conv -> LN stats -> mma.sync GEMM1 -> LN fold + exact GELU + GRN sumsq + fp16 hidden) is now built for the two missing HW >= 1024 rows. Each CTA takes one 2-row tile and all 16 warps work through it in order. 4,96 uses 112-token tiles padded to 128 (112 CTAs) with W1' resident in shared memory. 8,320 uses 64-token tiles (128 CTAs) and streams W1' in 64-row blocks of 40 KB, one buffer per 4-warp group, through a cp.async.bulk + mbarrier ring. Rented B200, same container as r7-me
